_comment: Hand-checked dish -> USDA FoodData Central (SR Legacy) mappings. EMPTY for the Indian taxonomy so far: until a dish is mapped here, core/nutrition.py falls back to automatic retrieval and labels the result 'estimated'. Entry format: "dish_key": {"fdc_id": "174289", "provenance": "verified" | "estimated" | "none", "note": "what the match is and what it leaves out"}. Use tools: python -c "from core import nutrition; print(nutrition.search('chickpeas cooked'))" to find candidates. fdc_id null with provenance 'none' means checked, no analogue exists.
